decision.reason: Teknisk Ukeblad October 13 describes collision of two maintenance trains in Romeriksporten during summer track works; railway worksite movement handoff and safe-permission evidence is a distinct preliminary software hypothesis. Details of actual cause remain unverified.

opportunities.core_job: Record authorized maintenance-train movements and conflicting worksite track reservations for human pre-shift review
opportunities.target_customer: Rail maintenance contractors and rail infrastructure worksite safety coordinators
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-entered track section/shift/train/crew plan -> conflicting reservations flag -> route possession and dispatch-authority checklist -> human signoff -> incident and deviation evidence export; advisory only, no live signalling
opportunities.why_now: 13 October 2026 reporting of a rail maintenance train collision creates a documented operational safety review trigger; accident cause is not established.
opportunities.before_state: Track works shift movement approvals and contractor handovers can be dispersed across radio, paper and spreadsheet logs.
opportunities.after_state: One auditable manual shift occupancy and work-train movement approval register highlights conflicting entries prior to a human decision.
